headline: Lions lose DB Avonte Maddox for season; Dan Campbell defends DC
summary: The embattled Lions defense has lost defensive back Avonte Maddox for the season, while coach Dan Campbell is defending second-year defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard.

headline: Report: Kelvin Banks is expected to have ankle surgery
summary: Word on Monday morning was that the Saints believed left tackle Kelvin Banks suffered a high-ankle sprain during Sunday's win over the Ravens and an update on Monday afternoon paints a bleaker picture for Banks.

headline: Bears Not Expecting Long-Term Caleb Williams Absence
summary: Caleb Williams was carted off the field Sunday after suffering a hamstring injury. Early optimism emerged with respect to a lengthy absence being avoided, and it appears that was well-placed. The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero reported on Monday that a serious injury is indeed not the case for Williams and the Bears. Shortly thereafter, head coach Ben Johnson appeared […]

headline: Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams week-to-week, likely will miss time
summary: While Williams appears to have avoided a major hamstring injury, he is likely to be sidelined.
